resources.string: Grandmother
You start knowing a good player and their character. If the Demon kills them, you die too.
[ICON: circle]\n[ICON: eye_open]Show the marked player\'s character token, then point to that player.[ICON: eye_closed]
If the Grandmother\'s grandchild was killed by the Demon tonight:\n• The Grandmother dies. [ICON: circle]
Sailor
Each night, choose an alive player: either you or they are drunk until dusk. You cannot die.
[ICON: eye_open]The Sailor points to an alive player.[ICON: eye_closed]\nThe chosen player or the Sailor becomes drunk.[ICON: circle]
The previously drunk player is sober.[ICON: circle]\n[ICON: eye_open]The Sailor points to an alive player.[ICON: eye_closed]\nThe chosen player or the Sailor becomes drunk.[ICON: circle]
Chambermaid
Each night, choose 2 alive players (not yourself): you learn how many woke tonight due to their ability.
[ICON: eye_open]The Chambermaid points to two alive players. Show with fingers (0, 1, or 2) how many woke tonight due to their ability.[ICON: eye_closed]
Exorcist
Each night*, choose a player (different from last night): the Demon, if chosen, learns who you are then does not wake tonight.

[ICON: eye_open]The Exorcist points to a player different from their previous choice.[ICON: eye_closed]
If this is the Demon:
•[ICON: eye_open]Wake the Demon. Show the Exorcist token. Point to the Exorcist.[ICON: eye_closed]
•The Demon does not wake again tonight.[ICON: circle]
Innkeeper
Each night*, choose 2 players: they cannot die tonight, but 1 is drunk until dusk.

Remove the previously protected players\' reminders.[ICON: circle]\n[ICON: eye_open]The Innkeeper points to two players.[ICON: eye_closed]They are safe [ICON: circle] and one of them is drunk.[ICON: circle]
Gambler
Each night*, choose a player and guess their character: if you guess wrong, you die.
[ICON: eye_open]The Gambler points to a player and a character on the sheet.[ICON: eye_closed]\nIf incorrect, the Gambler dies.[ICON: circle]
Gossip
Each day, you may make a public statement. Tonight, if it was true, a player dies.
If the Gossip\'s public statement was true:\n• Choose a player who can die tonight. That player dies.[ICON: circle]
Courtier
Once per game, at night, choose a character: they are drunk for 3 nights and 3 days.

[ICON: eye_open]The Courtier signals NO or chooses a character on the sheet.[ICON: eye_closed]\nIf the Courtier used their ability, mark it.[ICON: circle]\nIf the chosen character is in play, that player is drunk.[ICON: circle]

Reduce the marked player's remaining drunk duration.[ICON: circle]
If the Courtier has not used their ability:
•[ICON: eye_open]The Courtier signals NO or chooses a character on the sheet.[ICON: eye_closed]
•If the Courtier uses their ability, mark it.[ICON: circle] If the chosen character is in play, that player is drunk.[ICON: circle]
Professor
Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: if they are a Townsfolk, they are resurrected.

If the Professor has not used their ability:\n•[ICON: eye_open]The Professor signals NO or chooses a dead player.[ICON: eye_closed]\n•If the chosen player is a Townsfolk, they are resurrected.[ICON: circle]
Minstrel
When a Minion dies by execution, all other players (except Travellers) are drunk until dusk tomorrow.
Remove the Everyone Drunk reminder.[ICON: circle]\nIf a Minion died by execution today, everyone except the Minstrel and Travellers becomes drunk. Place the Everyone Drunk reminder.[ICON: circle]
Tea Lady
If both your alive neighbors are good, they cannot die.
Pacifist
Executed good players might not die.
Fool
The first time you die, you do not.
Tinker
You might die at any time.
The Tinker may die.[ICON: circle]
Moonchild
When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player. Tonight, if they are good, they die.
If the Moonchild chose a player with their ability today:\n• If that player is good, they die.[ICON: circle]
Goon
Each night, the 1st player to choose you with their ability is drunk until dusk. You become their alignment.
If a player used their ability on the Goon:\n•The Goon changes to that player\'s alignment.[ICON: circle]\n•[ICON: eye_open]Show the You Are card and indicate their new alignment.[ICON: eye_closed]
Lunatic
You think you are a Demon, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are and who you choose at night.

[ICON: eye_open]Wake the Lunatic and show the These Are Your Minions card. Point to as many players as there are real Minions in play.
•Show the These Characters Are Not in Play card and 3 good character tokens.[ICON: eye_closed]

[ICON: eye_open]Wake the Demon. Show the You Are card and the Demon token.
Show the Demon who the Lunatic is.[ICON: eye_closed]
[ICON: eye_open]Let the Lunatic act as their Demon character[ICON: eye_closed]:

Mark who the Lunatic attacked.[ICON: circle]\nIf the Lunatic attacked someone: [ICON: eye_open]Wake the Demon. Show the Lunatic attack reminder and point to the players chosen by the Lunatic.[ICON: eye_closed] Remove the Lunatic attack reminders.[ICON: circle]
Godfather
You start knowing which Outsiders are in play. If 1 died today, choose a player tonight: they die. [+1 or −1 Outsider]
[ICON: eye_open]Show the Outsider character tokens that are in play, without pointing to players.[ICON: eye_closed]
If an Outsider died today:\n[ICON: eye_open]The Godfather points to a player.[ICON: eye_closed] That player dies.[ICON: circle]
Devil\'s Advocate
Each night, choose a living player (different from last night): if executed tomorrow, they do not die.
[ICON: eye_open]The Devil\'s Advocate points to a living player.[ICON: eye_closed]\nThe chosen player survives execution tomorrow.[ICON: circle]
[ICON: eye_open]The Devil\'s Advocate points to a living player different from the previous choice.[ICON: eye_closed]\nThe chosen player survives execution tomorrow.[ICON: circle]
Assassin
Once per game, at night*, choose a player: they die, even if for some reason they could not.
If the Assassin has not used their ability:\n•[ICON: eye_open]The Assassin signals NO or chooses a player.[ICON: eye_closed] That player dies.[ICON: circle]
Mastermind
If the Demon dies by execution, play for 1 more day. If a player is then executed, their team loses.
Zombuul
Each night*, if no one died today, choose a player: they die. The 1st time you die, you live but register as dead.
If no one died today:\n•[ICON: eye_open]The Zombuul points to a player.[ICON: eye_closed] That player dies.[ICON: circle]
Pukka
Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned. The previously poisoned player dies then becomes healthy.
[ICON: eye_open]The Pukka points to a player.[ICON: eye_closed]That player is poisoned.[ICON: circle]
[ICON: eye_open]The Pukka points to a player.[ICON: eye_closed] That player is poisoned.[ICON: circle]\nThe previously poisoned player dies and becomes healthy.[ICON: circle]
Shabaloth
Each night*, choose 2 players: they die. A dead player you chose last night might be regurgitated.
A player chosen by the Shabaloth last night may be resurrected.[ICON: circle]\n[ICON: eye_open]The Shabaloth points to two players.[ICON: eye_closed]Those players die.[ICON: circle]
Po
Each night*, you may choose a player: they die. If your last choice was no one, choose 3 players tonight.

[ICON: eye_open]If the Po chose nobody last night [ICON: circle], the Po points to three players.[ICON: circle]\nOtherwise, the Po signals NO [ICON: circle] or chooses one player.[ICON: circle]\n[ICON: eye_closed]The marked players, if any, die.[ICON: circle]
Apprentice
On your 1st night, you gain a Townsfolk ability (if good) or a Minion ability (if evil).
Matron
Each day, you may choose up to 3 sets of 2 players to swap seats. Players may not leave their seats to talk in private.
Judge
Once per game, if another player nominated, you may choose to force the current execution to pass or fail.
Bishop
Only the Storyteller can nominate. At least 1 opposing player must be nominated each day.
Voudon
Only you and the dead can vote. They do not need a vote token. A 50% majority is not required.
